# Gridfinity bin with Pred-style snap-in label holder

- Customizable model by 3DLG (per the file header), made to take the matching snap-in labels from the Label Generator for Gridfinity (MakerWorld 769441).
- Based on ABDELat's parametric Gridfinity bin (MakerWorld 4759), itself based on kennetek's gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad.
